MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The imperial nuts and bolts complement my metric kits, while the set screws add a fastening option I do not already have; both fit my ongoing fabrication and repair work.",
    "The rivet assortment fits my repeated interest in fastening supplies, and disposable gloves could be useful for messy workshop tasks, though I would check sizes, fit, and suitability before choosing them."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "CNC end mills and breadboards assume specific kinds of projects that my drilling, cutting, and mechanical fastening history does not establish.",
    "Bearing balls and solid-copper wire connectors need a particular repair and compatible dimensions or materials; I have no current task that makes these useful.",
    "Another six-inch digital caliper matches my work but duplicates a tool I recently obtained, so relevance alone does not give me a reason to buy it."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning workshop tools seems to have been taken as interest in specialized equipment for any workshop activity.",
    "My repeated purchases of assortments seem to have been treated as a reason to offer more assortments without considering whether they add a useful capability or repeat supplies I already own."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The sizes and fastening methods matter: imperial bolts and set screws fill different needs from my existing metric bolts, rivets, and rivet nuts.",
    "Recent ownership matters for durable tools, while another supply assortment is useful only if it covers missing sizes or replenishes something I have used up.",
    "Specialized parts need a clear connection to the task and compatible equipment; a broad connection to repair work is not enough."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my fastening and repair interests but sometimes confuse workshop relevance with a current need or a useful addition to what I already own."
}
